findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V100 renders: both overskirt sides still show dense repeated transverse ridges and narrow pinching from waist to hem. This dominates front, rear, and side silhouettes; the canonical hem-role piping change did not resolve the independent cloth-surface defect.

The front and back views show the skirt hem trim projecting past the panel corners, and the side views show uneven, angular hem/corner transitions. The selected front-lap hem chain therefore still lacks a visually flush join with adjacent panel trim.

Crouch and sit previews show angular, stiff overlap at the hips and raised thighs, with the skirt panels folding into the legs rather than following a believable garment drape. The renders remain an unaccepted construction prototype; avatar fit, cloth calibration, weight/pose, UV, Unity/VRChat, and release gates are not established.

nextAction: Stop adjusting only the front-lap piping. Change the overskirt panel geometry/deformation source so its side surface no longer collapses into stacked transverse ridges, and redesign panel-edge trim joins so all adjacent hem paths terminate flush at shared corners. Then regenerate the 3D source and all eleven views; inspect side, crouch, sit, and front/rear corners directly. Keep the candidate rejected until visual quality and all required fit, skinning, shape-key, UV, runtime, and package evidence pass.
